label_context.note: The published NOTCH1-L1601P-DeltaP construct is described as an oncogenic experimental model. Human RefSeq NM_017617.5 encodes H at residue 1601, so this label is retained only as a gene/locus reference and is not asserted as a human RefSeq allele.
